instructions.question: What overall feeling does the tweet's author show toward its topic: positive, neutral, or negative?
instructions.rule: Positive needs the author's own warmth: looking forward to something, praise, good-luck wishes, tributes, or good news such as releases, tours, new products or wins. Hype, exclamation marks, party promos and recaps without a personal feeling are neutral, as are logistics, questions, speculation and calm sports or political analysis. Negative needs explicit annoyance, sadness, insults or personal setbacks (#fml, crying, :( ), critical rhetorical jabs, or news of harm or trouble: deaths, attacks, charges, scandals, investigations, war. Mock-dramatic fandom posts and joking stress stay neutral.

neutral.what: Information, promos, logistics, questions, predictions, opinions without emotional words, and joking exaggeration.
examples: @user come party with us tomorrow night in Naples Maine at Ricks cafe!!
Pochettino should have started Alli. He'll probably do a Kane and keep him on the bench till November. Might be too late for him this term
date: august 11th still no sign of frank ocean's new album. the world is turning on itself. buildings are burning. god refuses to comment.
neutral.cues: come party, tomorrow night, tickets, ?, should have, may, probably, lol
neutral.not_for: Clear personal excitement or praise (positive); real complaints, setbacks, or harmful news (negative).

positive.what: The author's own warmth, anticipation, praise, well-wishing or tribute, or good news such as wins, releases and launches.
examples: Guess who's going to see Foo Fighters on Tuesday!!!!! (ME)
New iPhones, iPad Pro, and Apple TV on the way today at 10 A.M. (PDT)! #AppleEvent
Happy Birthday Wilt Chamberlain may you rest in peace
positive.cues: good luck, can't wait, love, best, awesome, happy, see you, tribute, new album, :)
positive.not_for: Party or event hype without the author's own feeling (neutral); 'can't wait' used sarcastically (negative).

negative.what: Anger, sadness, insults, personal disappointment or inconvenience, critical jabs, and news of harm, scandal or trouble.
examples: Just remembered I'm taking the PSSAs tomorrow. #Fml
Caitlyn Jenner May Face Manslaughter Charge in Malibu Crash I read it on @user #video:
@user so the thing next Thursday isn't free, you'd have to pay $15 to get in since you don't go to UMBC :/ and it ends at 11:30"
negative.cues: sucks, wtf, #fml, crying, pity, ugh, :/, :(, killed, charge, problems, investigation, war, punished
negative.not_for: Calm analysis, hedged speculation, playful exaggeration, or RIP tributes praising someone (neutral or positive).
